name: Bitly
description: Create, track, and manage Bitly links and QR Codes directly from Claude without switching contexts. Access 27 comprehensive tools spanning link creation, analytics, organizational management, and more—making this the most complete link management solution available in any AI assistant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bitly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bitly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-ssl.bitly.com/v4/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bitly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bitly lists 27 MCP tools, including create_short_link, get_short_link_details, update_short_link, delete_short_link, expand, custom_backhalf, link_metrics, link_clicks_summary, link_countries, link_cities, link_devices, and link_referrers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bitly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bitly in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Bitly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bitly is developed by Bitly. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
